title: Piano trio at the Dew Drop with Buddy Charles and Papa John Joseph
summary: He started playing piano at Frank Painia's Dew Drop in a trio with Buddy Charles and bassist Papa John Joseph.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yeah, Frank Pena's place. I started playing piano there with Buddy Charles and, and, and Papa John. Remember Papa John played bass?
Uh, uh. Maybe I know him, too. Yeah, you know him. Or, Kaiser's brother. Yeah, we are, sure. Uh, John Joseph. John Joseph, yeah.
Yeah, they call him Papa John.

Yeah, Papa John, that's right. Yeah, John Joseph, you see? Yeah, sure, I know him, yeah. Yeah, see? So, uh, played with John Joseph, and Buddy Charles was playing guitar. We had a trio. And Papa John was old at that time, so, you know, he's still old. He's very old now. So, uh, but then after I left the, left the Dewdrop, I worked there about a year playing piano, maybe better than a year. I was playing piano, but then I got to be pretty good at it, you know? Uh-huh. Then we went at another place on Claiborne Street. Oh, I forgot the name of the place. I was playing piano. I mean, we played there a while. Then, uh, somebody heard that they needed, they wanted a trio in the French quarters. That's why we went at the, at the, the same place, the Shore Bar.
